meta.parties: Kanapathipillai v. Mohamadutamby Levai Et Al

rules.statement: A conveyance purporting to pass a clean title to purchasers for value and without notice acquires priority over subsequent deeds, even if the original grantor had no title at the time of the conveyance.
rules.supporting_quote: "We are not called upon here to inquire what the legal position would be if the subsequent purchaser had derived his title from a Fiscal's conveyance, which, in terms, passes only the right, title, and interest of the judgment-debtor. We are in presence of a conveyance purporting to pass a clean title to purchasers for value and without notice."
